observed_failure: On official EntailmentBank 340 test questions, 196 required four-plus exact proof leaf facts; sparse 120 candidate set contained all facts in 1/196, and a fixed sparse+dense 120 pool in 11/196. Among 117 source-available hard cases, almost all were still missing gold from the candidate pool. No method completed a 4+-fact proof set in Top 10.
baseline: Frozen V14C BM25/V7.1 and V14D sparse boosted/dense hybrid on original questions; V14D is an exploratory reuse of inspected public test.

SAG2.actual_mechanism: BM25 retrieval, contextual JEV necessary-evidence decisions, preserve selected passages, source passage -> bounded selected terms -> fresh BM25 candidates, then contextual rescoring; DPP only a final local diversity operator.
SAG2.what_pger_previously_tested: V12 tested DPP on top-ten boosted-ranked documents without running contextual JEV and source-anchored iterative evidence expansion.
SAG2.failure_specific_contrast: Our V14 search did not obtain the missing intermediate science proof facts; using an evidence-derived next-hop frontier could discover facts unreachable through only the original question.
SAG2.proposed_adaptation: Implement a bounded source-frontier query action selected only after detecting a provisional missing proof obligation; preserve source IDs and cost; compare with fixed equally budgeted generic expansion.
SAG2.costs_and_risks: JEV calls are material model cost; a boosted relevance score is not validated as equivalent to contextual necessary evidence; lexical terms can drift.
SAG2.falsifier: On new proof-tree source-disjoint questions with equal BM25 search actions, complete gold candidate recovery at a feasible TopK fails to beat matched generic expansion.

HippoRAG2.actual_mechanism: Offline OpenIE fact/entity graph with fact-to-passage provenance, embedding-based query anchoring and Personalized PageRank over grounded associations; query-time fact retrieval is linked to original passages.
HippoRAG2.what_pger_previously_tested: V12 tested TF-IDF document similarity plus query-local PPR, not true fact/entity extraction or validated typed edges.
HippoRAG2.failure_specific_contrast: Science proof intermediates connect by atomic facts and scientific relations; generic document word overlap has no typed graph edges to bridge undermentioned premises.
HippoRAG2.proposed_adaptation: Build a small, optional typed fact/passage adjacency with exact evidence spans, only traversing independently validated edges when present; report unseen edge error and offline extraction costs.
HippoRAG2.costs_and_risks: OpenIE and embedding indexing are expensive and can create hallucinated or wrong-direction edges; graph connectivity alone cannot verify an assertion.
HippoRAG2.falsifier: Verified graph-neighbor retrieval cannot recover missing gold proof facts beyond source frontier / dense on a new source-disjoint dataset under same index/query budget.

S2GRAG.actual_mechanism: A trained sufficiency judge reads original question plus compressed sentence evidence, produces structured missing-fact slots and controls whether to launch targeted retrieval or stop.
S2GRAG.what_pger_previously_tested: V12 tested uncovered lexical query words, not a learned sufficiency model or atomic missing propositions.
S2GRAG.failure_specific_contrast: V14 full candidate coverage failed because later necessary science facts often are not named in the original question; a missing relation could target a useful intermediate premise.
S2GRAG.proposed_adaptation: Propose a structured provisional missing atomic fact with subject, relation, object placeholder, direction, negation/time, quoted context, and budget; never certify it until independently verified.
S2GRAG.costs_and_risks: Training judge needs labeled gaps and may hallucinate useful-looking false premises; V13B MiniLM safety failure prohibits using unvalidated entailment scores.
S2GRAG.falsifier: On independent human-labeled missing-fact targets, gap precision and full candidate recovery do not exceed no-gap source-frontier search while respecting false-proof rates and search cost.

pger_native_proposal: Keep PGER competing hypotheses and proof-gap ledger; cheaply retrieve; form provisional typed missing evidence obligations; choose budgeted SAG2 source frontier, Hippo grounded fact neighbor or S2G structured gap query action; preserve provenance; allow answer only when external edge verification is independently validated, else continue bounded search or abstain.
preregistered_evaluation: New held-out source/topic-disjoint human proof-tree questions, measured full gold availability, candidate complete 5/10/20 and full pool, true proof depth, human fact-edge precision/false entailment, answer accuracy when answers generated, 0/1/2/3 matched extra search actions and CPU/wall p95/index/model costs; no oracle inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Promotion requires paired confidence intervals supporting a meaningful increase in complete evidence at feasible K without easy-question regression, missing/contradiction false-proof control, and matched offline+online cost within frozen constraints; replicates on unseen sources.
